quarterly_data.quarter: NVIDIA press release: NVIDIA Advances Isaac Platform for General-Purpose Robotics (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: NVIDIA (release): NVIDIA Isaac Lab 3.0 is now generally available, and NVIDIA added the Isaac OS open-source runtime, open reference workflows for DGX Station and a SimReady Central Library of more than 2,000 assets; Agile Robots' Agile ONE SN reference humanoid, built on Isaac GR00T and Jetson Thor (2,070 FP4 teraflops, 128GB unified memory), is scheduled to be available in early 2027. Robotics companies building on NVIDIA robotics platforms include ABB Robotics, KUKA, Sereact, Humanoid, Hexagon Robotics and NEURA Robotics, and Schaeffler contributes its actuator technology as an exclusive foundational component for Newton; Bellboy's Billie robot on Jetson and GR00T is deployed at hotels.
quarterly_data.figure: Isaac Lab 3.0 generally available; Agile ONE SN early 2027
